answer: A cheap identity gate lets a farm spin up clones, so price sybil resistance by demanding original, jury-scored judgment per identity each epoch, plus a shared-generation fingerprint over submission diffs. The mechanism works because clones that share one intent are like a tundra spread wide but built from one root: strip the saffron-colored surface and the meadow of identical scaffolding shows through. That shared timber is the tell, raising attacker cost to sustained novel reasoning.
